fact: The third national statistics development strategy (May 2022) states the statistics law is Loi no 2004-011 of 30 March 2004, amended by Loi no 2014-066 of 5 November 2014, and that a revised bill had been prepared and submitted to the government for adoption.
title: Troisième Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS) 2022-2026
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Niger (Ministère du Plan)
